title: Cohesity Activity
description: Live work across the estate: backup runs, replication, archives and recoveries.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(cohesity_runs_active{cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_recoveries_active{cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_runs_24h{cluster=~"$cluster",status=~"succeeded|succeededwithwarning"}) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_runs_24h{cluster=~"$cluster",status=~"failed|missed|canceled"}) or vector(0), "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_group_24h_sla_violations{cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace((count(cohesity_replication_last_status{cluster=~"$cluster",status=~"failed|canceled"}) or vector(0)) + (count(cohesity_archive_last_status{cluster=~"$cluster",status=~"failed|canceled"}) or vector(0)), "k", "5", "", "")

panels.title: Running backup runs
panels.description: One row per backup run in progress (status accepted, running, on hold, finalizing, paused or canceling). Progress and remaining time come from the run's progress call, which the collector makes for up to 50 running runs per cluster. 'First seen' is when the collector first saw the run in progress.
